equipment.name: Lance
equipment.rules: Charge: +1 die if this war-walker has moved 2 or more hexes this activation.

equipment.name: Melee Blade
equipment.rules: Rolls of 5 or 6 are criticals.

equipment.name: Carapace Gun
equipment.rules: Mounts on the core, not an arm. No ammo. Pierce 1.

equipment.name: Missile Rack
equipment.rules: Indirect.

equipment.name: Rail Cannon
equipment.rules: Pierce 2. If the war-walker moved this activation, +2 TN instead of +1 (Gyro Stabilisers remove it).

equipment.name: Rocket Pod
equipment.rules: Blast: also roll 1 die against each war-walker adjacent to the target. Minimum range 4.

equipment.name: Industrial Claw
equipment.rules: If it hits, push the target 1 hex directly away.

equipment.name: Arc Cannon
equipment.rules: No ammo. Each hit also drains 1 Pressure from the target's next activation.

equipment.name: Hellfire Missiles
equipment.rules: Indirect. Each hit adds 1 Overpressure to the target.

equipment.name: Kinetic Claws
equipment.rules: Backstab: rolls of 5 or 6 are criticals when attacking from the target's rear arc.

equipment.name: Ablative Plating
equipment.rules: +2 Armour on the location it is fitted to (front and rear core). Two or more on one war-walker: -1 Stride.

equipment.name: Reactive Shell
equipment.rules: Ignore the first hit against this war-walker each round.

equipment.name: Kinetic Shield
equipment.rules: Reaction, when hit: spend Reserve, each point cancels 1 damage from that hit.

equipment.name: Smoke Launcher
equipment.rules: Place smoke in this or an adjacent hex until the end phase.

equipment.name: Jump Jets
equipment.rules: Jump up to 3 hexes ignoring terrain, elevation and war-walkers in between. +1 Overpressure. Counts as moving.

equipment.name: Sprint Servos
equipment.rules: +1 Stride on the first Move action each activation.

equipment.name: Gyro Stabilisers
equipment.rules: Ignore the attacker-moved TN penalty, including the Rail Lance's extra +1.

equipment.name: Anchor Spikes
equipment.rules: Anchor: cannot be pushed or knocked down and gets Brace's +1 TN until it next moves. +1 die on long-range attacks while anchored.

equipment.name: Targeting Array
equipment.rules: -1 TN on all your attacks.

equipment.name: Coolant Loop
equipment.rules: Remove 2 Overpressure.

equipment.name: Overcharged Boiler
equipment.rules: +1 Boiler rating. Faults are rolled from 2 Overpressure instead of 3.

equipment.name: Soul Lantern
equipment.rules: Enemy attacks against friendly war-walkers within 2 hexes of this one get +1 TN. Does not stack.

equipment.name: Spotter Drone
equipment.rules: Mark an enemy within 8 hexes (no line of sight needed within 4). Friendly attacks against it get -1 TN until the end phase, and it counts as seen for Indirect fire.

equipment.name: Field Repair Rig
equipment.rules: Restore 2 Armour to one location on this or an adjacent friendly war-walker.
